name: Why is proper water pressure important in homes in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: Why is proper water pressure important in homes in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining proper water pressure is crucial for homes in Las Vegas to protect your plumbing system and ensure optimal performance of appliances. High pressure can stress pipes, lead to leaks, and damage water heaters, dishwashers, and washing machines, potentially leading to costly repairs due to the hard water conditions prevalent in the region. Conversely, low pressure can make showers weak and reduce appliance efficiency. A properly functioning PRV ensures a consistent, safe pressure, extending the life of your plumbing and fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper water pressure protects plumbing and appliances from damage due to high pressure (common with hard water in Las Vegas) and ensures efficient function.
